title: 第二章
slug: 娇软妹宝随军后禁欲军官沦陷了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

傅谨严是今天早上才下的火车，原本是想执行军务的地方离家很近，回来看看，却不想看了出大戏。

听到苏云如口口声声要她女儿跟自己生米煮成熟饭，傅谨严对两人的厌恶更上一层。

刚想出去戳破两人丑恶的嘴脸，却见副官走到他面前，“傅团，军区传来消息，你叔叔说你妹妹在家总被流氓骚扰，所以想要随军一段时间，问你是否同意？”

“呵，”傅谨严冷笑一声，什么被流氓骚扰，只怕都是那对母女为了随军胡编乱造的。

“跟他们说...”傅谨严下意识就要拒绝，但又想到傅大山平日提起这对母女，总是诸多信任，话到嘴边又咽了回去，“就说我同意了。”

与其让她继续哄骗傅大山，还不如把人放到眼皮底下看住。

“是。”副官把他意思转达给军区后，傅谨严也没心情回家了。

而是买了次日的车票，打算回军区。

而另一边，别看傅大山中午说的信誓旦旦，可对傅谨严是否同意却十分没底。

只因他知道，这些年苏云如和苏清荔在外风评一直都不大好，虽然他知道那些都是谣言，也从未放在心上，但傅谨严却不一定。

万一事情搞砸，该怎么对她俩交代？

就在傅大山急得团团转时，军区的电话总算是打了过来。

听到傅谨严同意后，傅大山长长松了一口气。

恰在此时，去镇上买衣服的母女也回来了。

傅大山自然把消息告诉了她们。

“太好了，那明天一早就买车票，让清荔过去。”苏云如说。

“这么急？”这下这下轮到苏清荔惊讶了，“我还想多陪你们几天呢。”

苏清荔不知道的是，就在前几天，郑瑞闲已经下了最后通牒，说在不把苏清荔嫁给他，就要日日守在傅家门前。

所以，苏母才会那么着急。

傅大山知道此事，所以也说，“你妈也是怕郑家在闹出什么幺蛾子，还是快点动身，以后陪我们的机会多的是呢。”

眼看两人坚持，苏清荔也不好在说什么，而是收拾东西了。

与此同时，郑瑞闲派出蹲守在傅家的小弟刘勇，看着苏云如母女提着大包小包东西，进进出出，心中有些怪异。

也不逢年过节的，买那么多东西干吗？

带着这个疑问，刘勇躺在床上辗转腾挪，直到凌晨四点，才猛地一激灵，苏清荔不会是要跑吧？

想到自己可能要立大功，刘勇满眼兴奋的跑到郑瑞闲住的地方。

“老大！快醒醒！”

彼时郑瑞闲睡得正香，猛地被他吵醒，杀人的心思都有了“大半夜你要死啊！”

刘勇被他踹的一个趔趄，却顾不上计较，而是将今日见闻都跟他说了一遍。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fu Jingyan just got off the train this morning. He originally wanted to perform military duties near home, but when he came back to visit, he didn't want to watch a big show.

Hearing Su Yunru repeatedly asking her daughter to cook rice with him, Fu Jinyan's disgust towards the two of them became even higher.

Just as he was about to go out and expose the ugly faces of the two men, he saw the adjutant walking up to him and said, "Tuan Fu, there is news from the military region. Your uncle said that your sister is always harassed by gangsters at home, so he wants to join the army for a while. Do you agree?"

"Ha," Fu Jingyan sneered. The idea of being harassed by gangsters was probably just made up by the mother and daughter in order to join the army.

"Tell them..." Fu Jingyan subconsciously wanted to refuse, but he thought of how much Fu Dashan always trusted the mother and daughter when he mentioned it, so he swallowed it back, "Just say I agree."

Rather than letting her continue to coax Fu Dashan, it would be better to put him under her nose and watch him.

"Yes." After the adjutant conveyed his intention to the military area, Fu Jinyan was not in the mood to go home.

Instead, I bought a ticket for the next day and planned to go back to the military area.

On the other hand, despite what Fu Dashan said at noon, he was very unsure whether Fu Jinyan agreed.

Just because he knew that Su Yunru and Su Qingli's reputation abroad had not been very good over the years. Although he knew those were rumors and never took them to heart, Fu Jinyan was not sure.

What should I do to them if things go wrong?

Just when Fu Dashan was anxious, the phone call from the military region finally came.

After hearing Fu Jinyan's agreement, Fu Dashan breathed a long sigh of relief.

Just at this time, the mother and daughter who went to town to buy clothes also came back.

Fu Dashan naturally told them the news.

"Great, then buy a ticket tomorrow morning and let Qingli go there." Su Yunru said.

"So urgent?" Now it was Su Qingli's turn to be surprised, "I want to stay with you for a few more days."

What Su Qingli didn't know was that just a few days ago, Zheng Ruixian had given an ultimatum, saying that if she didn't marry Su Qingli to him, he would stay in front of the Fu family every day.

That's why Mother Su was so anxious.

Fu Dashan knew about this, so he also said, "Your mother is also afraid that the Zheng family will cause trouble, so she should leave quickly. There will be many opportunities to accompany us in the future."

Seeing that the two persisted, Su Qingli didn't know what to say and packed her things.

At the same time, Zheng Ruixian sent his younger brother Liu Yong to stay at Fu's house. He felt a little strange as he watched Su Yunru and her daughter carrying large and small bags in and out.

It’s not a holiday, so why buy so many things?

With this question in mind, Liu Yong lay on the bed and tossed around until four o'clock in the morning, when he suddenly got excited. Is Su Qingli trying to run away?

Thinking that he might make a great contribution, Liu Yong ran to where Zheng Ruixian lived with eyes full of excitement.

"Boss! Wake up!"

At that time, Zheng Ruixian was sleeping soundly when he was suddenly woken up by him. He had murderous thoughts on his mind, "You are going to die in the middle of the night!"

Liu Yong staggered after being kicked by him, but he didn't care and told him everything he saw today.
